sections.content: You know *deber* and *tener que* and *te recomiendo que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 7, *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27, and *para que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 7. Here you use them to give advice about food and health. When the advice is about what another person does, expressions such as *es importante que*, *es mejor que* and *te recomiendo que* are followed by the present subjunctive. Connect the advice to a reason or an expected benefit.

items.spanish: Es importante que comas de forma equilibrada, aunque no tienes que cambiarlo todo de una vez.
items.english: It is important that you eat a balanced diet, although you do not have to change everything at once.

items.spanish: Te recomiendo que moderes el consumo de azúcar porque puede afectar a tu salud.
items.english: I recommend that you limit your sugar consumption because it can affect your health.

items.spanish: Es mejor que elijas alimentos nutritivos cuando tengas tiempo para cocinar.
items.english: It is better that you choose nutritious foods when you have time to cook.

items.spanish: Deberías preparar más comida en casa para que controles mejor lo que comes.
items.english: You should prepare more food at home so that you have better control over what you eat.

sections.content: After a recommendation expression with *que*, use the subjunctive when the recommendation refers to another action or subject.
